components.css: .ds-listen { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0.75rem; width: 100%; max-width: 32rem; font-family: Raleway, sans-serif; } .ds-listen-label { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #bdb6c5); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-listen-link { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; min-height: 52px; padding: 0.75rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(190,174,151,0.25)); border-radius: 2px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-listen-link svg { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-listen-lead { grid-column: 1 / -1; } .ds-listen-primary { background: var(--gold-bright, #e0c393); border-color: var(--gold-bright, #e0c393); color: var(--bg-base, #111015); } .ds-listen-primary:hover, .ds-listen-primary:focus-visible { background: #ead7af; border-color: #ead7af; } .ds-listen-primary:active { background: var(--gold, #c4a576); border-color: var(--gold, #c4a576); } .ds-listen-secondary { background: var(--surface, #19161e); color: var(--ink, #eee9e3); } .ds-listen-secondary svg { color: var(--gold, #c4a576); } .ds-listen-secondary:hover, .ds-listen-secondary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--gold, #c4a576); background: var(--surface-raised, #25202c); color: var(--gold-bright, #e0c393); } .ds-listen-secondary:active { background: var(--surface-strong, #201c26); } .ds-listen-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-bright, #e0c393); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-listen-link { transition: none; } } @media (max-width: 340px) { .ds-listen { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

components.css: .ds-release-index { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem 0 0; font-family: Raleway, sans-serif; } .ds-release-index ol { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0 1.5rem; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-release-index-label { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #bdb6c5); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-release-index a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--ink, #eee9e3); font-size: 1rem; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--gold-dim, #a48a65); text-underline-offset: 0.3em; transition: text-decoration-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-release-index a:hover { color: var(--gold-bright, #e0c393); text-decoration-color: var(--gold-bright, #e0c393); } .ds-release-index a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-bright, #e0c393); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-release-index, .ds-release-index ol { flex-wrap: nowrap; gap: 0 1.25rem; } .ds-release-index { padding: 1rem 0 0.25rem; overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-x: contain; scrollbar-width: none; } .ds-release-index::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; } .ds-release-index li, .ds-release-index-label { flex-shrink: 0; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-release-index a:focus-visible { outline-offset: 3px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-release-index a { transition: none; } }

components.css: .ds-tracks { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: Raleway, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #eee9e3); } .ds-tracks li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.5rem 56px minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 1rem 0; } .ds-tracks li + li { border-top: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(190,174,151,0.25)); } .ds-tracks .n, .ds-tracks .d { color: var(--ink-soft, #bdb6c5); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-tracks .art { aspect-ratio: 1; background: var(--surface-raised, #25202c); } .ds-tracks .t { font-weight: 500; } .ds-tracks button { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--gold, #c4a576); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--gold-bright, #e0c393); font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tracks button:hover { background: var(--gold-hover, color-mix(in srgb, #c4a576 12%, transparent)); } .ds-tracks button:active { background: var(--gold-press, color-mix(in srgb, #c4a576 20%, transparent)); } .ds-tracks button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-bright, #e0c393); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-track-more { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 44px; margin-top: 0.5rem; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gold-dim, #a48a65); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #eee9e3); font-family: Raleway, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-track-more:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--gold-bright, #e0c393); } .ds-track-more:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold-bright, #e0c393); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-track-more svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; color: var(--gold, #c4a576); transition: transform 200ms ease; } .ds-track-more[aria-expanded="true"] svg { transform: rotate(180deg); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-track-more, .ds-track-more svg { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Weathered stone with gold in the cracks. Everything on the page is restrained, dark, and still, except where the light gets in. The palette comes straight from the Reverie cover: violet-grey stone, a charcoal night, chalk-pale relief, and gold that shows up in the fractures. Gold is not a fill colour for surfaces. It is where emphasis lives: headings, the one primary action, focus rings, and the hairline under a link.

The release's cover art is the one dominant image on every surface it appears on. The interface keeps out of its way: no simulated stars, gradients, orbit ornaments, autoplay, or decorative motion compete with it. Cinzel carries the inscription-like lettering of the record into headings and navigation; Raleway keeps longer album and track copy readable. Density is low, with generous gutters and one idea per band of the page. Surfaces separate by tone rather than by boxes and borders.

The identity is faceless. The circular Pneumaris emblem, its hooded-figure header and intro derivatives, and the release artwork carry the project. People and performance never do.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only (`color-scheme: dark`): charcoal ground, violet-stone surfaces, chalk text.
Gold reserved for emphasis: headings, the primary action, focus, link underlines.
Cover art leads; square, uncropped, never overlaid.
Cinzel for display and navigation, Raleway for reading and controls.
No decorative motion; only feedback transitions, and all of them off under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Gold-in-the-Cracks Rule
rules.body: Gold marks emphasis, never area. The only gold fill is the single primary action; everything else gold is text, a line, an icon, or a focus ring.

rules.name: The One Stone Rule
rules.body: All neutrals come from the violet-stone family, and every translucent tint is mixed from a token: the `--gold-wash`, `--gold-hover` and `--gold-press` tints behind outline controls, or `color-mix()` on `--gold`, `--ink`, `--surface` or `--bg-base`. Never hardcode a colour literal in a component, so a palette change carries everywhere.

rules.name: The Inscription Rule
rules.body: Cinzel is for names, headings, and navigation: things that would be carved. Never set paragraphs, durations, or form input in it.

rules.name: The Readable Floor Rule
rules.body: Running text and control labels stay at 1rem. Nothing a visitor must read goes below 0.875rem (track numbers and player messages are the floor). The cookie banner's 11.5px text is below this floor.

rules.name: The One Image Rule
rules.body: Each band of the page has at most one image, and on the release hero it is the cover. Nothing overlays or crops it.

rules.name: The Flat Stone Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the page flow casts a shadow. Only fixed or modal layers do.

dos: Do let the current release's full, uncropped cover be the one dominant image on the homepage.
Do keep gold for emphasis: headings, one filled primary action, focus rings, link underlines.
Do separate sections by tone (charcoal ↔ violet stone) and space, keeping dividers for the header, footer, and track rows.
Do use the 2px corner and 1px borders on every new control, and keep targets at least 44px.
Do keep Cinzel for names, headings and navigation, and Raleway at 1rem for everything read.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion`; feedback transitions are 160–240ms colour and opacity changes only.
donts: Don't add simulated stars, gradients, orbit ornaments, autoplay, or entrance animations that compete with the cover.
Don't wrap catalogue items in cards or boxes.
Don't fill surfaces with gold, or use more than one filled gold button in a view.
Don't introduce warm-brown neutrals or the older `rgba(184, 154, 106, …)` gold; use the violet-stone and gold tokens.
Don't use people, faces, or performance imagery; the artwork and emblem carry the identity.
Don't add decorative blur to the header or a fade-in to the page.
